name: Synge-world-function distance is geometric but force-blind (distance != alpha=4 stress-tensor force)
claim: The Ansel (arXiv:2405.02380) Synge-world-function map d(r) ~ sqrt(-2 eps^2 ln C(r)), applied to critical-Ising MERA sigma-sigma (ZZ) connected-correlator data, recovers a monotone effective geodesic separation d(r) that grows ~linearly with boundary lattice separation r and is therefore a legitimate emergent-distance object -- BUT this Synge distance is structurally DISTINCT from, and CANNOT reproduce, the alpha~4 holographic force profile (HYP-008 SUPPORTED). Specifically: (i) a least-squares fit of d(r) = sqrt(-2 eps^2 ln|C(r)|) versus r is well-described by d(r) proportional to r (linear, slope set by eps and the CFT correlator decay exponent 2*Delta_sigma = 1/4); and (ii) the negative logarithmic derivative of the correlator -d ln|C| / d ln r scales as ~2*Delta_sigma = 0.25, NOT as the force exponent alpha~4 -- formally, a distance built from a single two-point function carries only the lightest-primary dimension Delta_sigma = 1/8, not the stress-tensor dimension Delta_T = 2, so distance and force are governed by different operators. This closes the 'correlator -> geometry' thread by formalizing why HYP-012 (correlator -> FORCE via CMI, NOT_SUPPORTED) and HYP-014/022 (Crofton integral-geometry FORCE, REFUTED) each failed for structurally different reasons than the Ansel distance map: HYP-012 and HYP-014 mis-mapped a distance-class object onto a force, whereas Ansel correctly keeps it a distance.
confidence_rationale: Medium. (1) The prediction is a sharp NULL/limit statement, not a hopeful positive: it predicts the Synge distance is geometric (positive content) but force-blind (the limiting/null content), and BOTH halves are independently checkable. (2) The operator accounting is a CFT theorem, not a fit: a two-point function C(r) ~ r^{-2*Delta_sigma} of the spin field carries Delta_sigma = 1/8 (Ising), so any distance functional of C alone is controlled by Delta_sigma; the alpha~4 force is controlled by the stress tensor Delta_T = 2 (HYP-008's established interpretation). These are different numbers by construction, so the distance-cannot-be-the-force conclusion is strongly motivated a priori. (3) Held below high because: the Synge map has a free regulator eps and a small-C regime of validity; and the existing SIM-2026-011 on-disk correlators (analytical Evenbly-White MERA on |0>^16, n_layers=3) are flat with a non-monotonicity at r=4 (|C(4)|=0.645 deeper than its neighbors) that the feasibility-checker confirmed will falsify the linear/monotone prediction unless clean sigma-sigma correlators are first regenerated -- the demonstration therefore rests on the synthetic clean-CFT cross-check plus regenerated connected correlators, not the raw on-disk set.
test_design: Local CPU re-analysis (no quantum hardware, no cloud). Steps: (1) Obtain clean critical-Ising MERA sigma-sigma correlators. The on-disk SIM-2026-011 zz_correlators (r=1..8) are flat/non-monotone (analytical-MERA proxy) and CANNOT validate the prediction; per the mandatory feasibility gate, either (a) regenerate exact-diag <sigma_i sigma_{i+r}>_connected from the 24q critical-TFIM ground state used in SIM-2026-011-interaction.json (a short recompute from the raw GS), or (b) restrict the primary demonstration to the synthetic clean-CFT correlator C_cft(r)=r^{-1/4} and label the on-disk MERA correlators as a known-pathological control. (2) Form the CONNECTED correlator C_conn(r) = <Z_i Z_{i+r}> - <Z_i><Z_{i+r}> (subtract the magnetization). (3) Compute the Synge distance d(r) = sqrt(-2 eps^2 ln|C_conn(r)|) for eps = 1, and verify all SHAPE conclusions (monotonicity, slope) are eps-independent (eps only rescales the axis). (4) Fit d(r) vs r to (a) a linear model and (b) a power law; record R^2 and slope/exponent; predicted outcome: linear with high R^2 (flat emergent metric at this scale). (5) FORCE-BLINDNESS gate: compute kappa(r) = -d ln|C_conn| / d ln r and confirm it is ~0.25 (=2*Delta_sigma), FAR from alpha~4. (6) Cross-check the SAME map on synthetic C_cft(r)=r^{-1/4}; divergence localizes lattice/finite-N distortion (especially the r=4 artifact). ~40 lines NumPy/SciPy, <1 hour.
refutation_criteria: Two halves, each independently falsifiable. GEOMETRIC half is REFUTED if the Synge distance d(r) from the connected, magnetization-subtracted correlators is NON-MONOTONE in r beyond what the clean-CFT cross-check attributes to the known r=4 lattice artifact -- i.e. if d(r) does not increase with separation even on the artifact-free synthetic correlator, the Synge map does not yield a sensible emergent distance here. FORCE-BLINDNESS half is REFUTED (the SURPRISING, program-relevant outcome) if the local exponent kappa(r) of the distance-defining correlator scales as ~4 rather than ~0.25 -- that would mean the sigma-sigma correlator itself carries the stress-tensor exponent, collapsing the distance/force distinction and contradicting Delta_sigma = 1/8. INCONCLUSIVE (NEEDS_REFINEMENT) if the r=4 non-monotonicity dominates the fit so badly that neither model achieves R^2 > 0.9 even after the clean-CFT cross-check isolates the artifact -- then the on-disk correlators are too finite-N-contaminated and a fresh chi>=3 MERA correlator extraction at N=16,24 is required first.
hardware_required: Local CPU only. NumPy/SciPy re-analysis of sigma-sigma correlators (regenerated connected correlators from the existing 24q GS, or the synthetic clean-CFT cross-check). No new state-prep, no quantum hardware, no cloud cost.
feasibility_notes: FEASIBILITY-CHECKER VERDICT (2026-06-11): DATA-EXISTENCE CHECK -- PARTIAL/MISLEADING. research/data/simulations/SIM-2026-011.json DOES store zz_correlators for r=1..8 (no new state-prep, local CPU, <1hr). HOWEVER these come from the analytical brick-wall MERA on |0>^16 (an approximate-CFT proxy) and are nearly FLAT with a NON-MONOTONICITY at r=4: |C| = {1:0.443, 2:0.493, 3:0.411, 4:0.645, 5:0.386, 6:0.388, 7:0.388, 8:0.391}; the file records power_law_fit_alpha=null. The clean 24q force data lives in SIM-2026-011-interaction.json, but that file stores F(dr) energies/norms, NOT sigma-sigma C(r) -- so HYP-026 cannot swap to it; the only on-disk C(r) is the flat/pathological set. SYNGE-MAP MATH: d(r)=sqrt(-2 eps^2 ln|C(r)|) is well-posed where |C|<1 (satisfied) but yields a monotone-INCREASING distance only for monotone-DECREASING |C(r)|. Since |C(4)|=0.645 > |C(3)|=0.411, the map gives d(4)<d(3): prediction (i) is FALSIFIED by the very data cited; prediction (ii) kappa~0.25 also fails on this flat data. EPS REGULATOR: a pure multiplicative prefactor (d proportional to eps); it rescales but does NOT change shape/monotonicity/log-slope, so eps is not the problem -- the source data is. OPERATOR-DIMENSION ACCOUNTING IS SOUND: a distance from a single sigma-sigma two-point function carries Delta_sigma=1/8 (log-slope 0.25), structurally distinct from stress-tensor Delta_T=2 (alpha=4); this null/limit statement is the valuable contribution and correctly explains the HYP-012 / HYP-014/022 failures. But it can only be DEMONSTRATED on clean C(r); the synthetic cross-check C_cft(r)=r^{-1/4} is the part that will show kappa->0.25 and linear d(r). KILLER-ISSUE CLEARANCE (R1-R5 all clear): R1 static re-analysis, no quasiparticle/decay; R2 no product-of-single-site-density estimator (uses connected correlators with magnetization subtracted); R3 no S_topo=-ln(2) claim; R4 no collision-probability TEE; R5 no unrun production gate / no AWS. VERDICT RATIONALE: math sound and all R1-R5 clear, but the on-disk correlators cannot validate predictions (i)/(ii); the unblock is cheap and specified -> NEEDS_REFINEMENT, not TESTABLE_NOW (data can't show the claimed shape) and not INFEASIBLE (no physics/math barrier).
feasibility_mandatory_gates: Source clean monotone sigma-sigma C(r): either (a) regenerate exact-diag <sigma_i sigma_j>_connected from the 24q critical-TFIM GS used in SIM-2026-011-interaction.json (a short recompute; that file stores F(dr)/norms, NOT C(r)), or (b) restrict the d(r)/kappa(r) demonstration to the synthetic C_cft(r)=r^{-1/4} cross-check and label the on-disk MERA correlators as a known-pathological control.

Handle the r=4 non-monotonicity explicitly: report that the raw analytical-MERA |C(r)| is non-monotone at r=4, use connected (magnetization-subtracted) correlators and re-check monotonicity, or exclude r=4 with stated justification. Do not report 'd(r) linear in r' against data that violates it.
Confirm eps-independence of all SHAPE conclusions in writing (kappa(r) and monotonicity are eps-invariant; only the absolute scale of d depends on eps).
philosophical_implications: [SPECULATIVE, interpretive_confidence=medium] That emergent DISTANCE (Synge world-function from a single two-point correlator, carrying Delta_sigma=1/8) and emergent FORCE (alpha~4, owned by Delta_T=2) are provably carried by different CFT operators is best read as a genuine operator-resolved ontological seam, not a reconstruction artifact: the boundary theory's primary decomposition is a coordinate-free fact about the same state, so a 'distance' built from the order-parameter sector and a 'force' built from the stress-tensor sector are structurally distinct emergent objects rather than two views of one geometric substance, favoring a layered/structural-realist reading in which the emergent 'spacetime' is a STACK of operator-resolved structures rather than a single manifold-with-metric that simultaneously fixes both intervals and dynamics. The null/limit form carries unusually clean positive interpretive weight precisely because it is a derived impossibility theorem keyed to operator dimensions (a Delta=1/8 object cannot encode Delta=2 dynamics) rather than a parameter-tuning failure -- epistemically stronger than the REFUTED Crofton route: Crofton was a positive geometric MECHANISM falsified by mismatched exponents, whereas HYP-026 explains WHY any single-correlator-to-force route (HYP-012, HYP-014/022) must fail, converting three scattered negative results into one principled selection rule. The diagnosis sharpens the program insight that 'exponent match is not mechanism': conflating geometric length-data with gravitational force-data is conflating distinct sectors of the emergent ontology, so the worldline arena should be understood as sector-indexed from the ground up rather than as a pre-given metric space from which forces are later derived. Frameworks: structural realism (operator-resolved/ontic), layered emergence, holographic principle, philosophy of null results and selection rules. The speculative load-bearing step is the leap from 'different operators' (a robust structural/computational fact) to 'different ontological strata'.
